messages:
Ana: Heads up — Catalina Health is requesting a focused enablement session for their engineering + security teams next week. Renewal convo in ~6 weeks; they want a hands-on migration + Dedicated capacity walk. Prefer APAC-friendly times (15:00-18:00 ET / 20:00-23:00 CET). Can we pull together agenda + owners?

Sam: Sounds good. I think 90m workshop + 30m office-hours drop-in after works. Who's owning the migration lab?

Mira: I can lead the migration lab (hands-on VM -> Dedicated demo). Will need a test workspace and sample config from their infra team. @Jordan can you send the intake form? :+1:

Jordan: Yep — I'll spin up a sign-up + intake: https://forms.redwood.test/catalina-enable — will include fields for IAM, VPC details, preferred times. Picking Tues/Thu to maximize overlap with AMER/APAC.

Kevin: I can cover networking/KMS and private deployment checklist. Prefer slot at 17:00 ET so APAC folks can join?

Ana: 17:00 ET is fine. Let's tentatively propose: Tue 17:00 ET (Thu fallback). Aim for 90m hands-on + 30m optional office hours same day.

Sam: Agenda draft — feel free to copy/edit:
```
- 0-10m: Introductions + goals
- 10-30m: Architecture review (Catalina infra + compliance needs)
- 30-75m: Migration lab (sample app -> Dedicated)
- 75-90m: Q&A / blockers
- 90-120m: Optional office hours (bookable 1:1 slots)
```

Mira: Need a sandbox cluster and SSH creds (read-only) from their infra to run the lab. Jordan, add that question to intake.

Jordan: Done. Also added timezone picker + renewal flag checkbox (so we can prioritize).

Ana: Important — Catalina is flagged as 'amber' on renewals (low usage signal). Let's capture success metrics we can show post-session. @CS Bot, add to renewal board.

CS Bot: Catalina Health added to renewal-risk board (status: amber). Created enablement epic and linked intake form.

Kevin: Quick note — I'll prepare a short runbook snippet for KMS + cert rotation to drop into their repo.

Sam: I'll handle slide deck + migration checklist. Can someone volunteer to run a dry-run on Mon?

Mira: I can do a 30m dry-run Mon 09:30 PT (12:30 ET).

Ana: Great — confirm final invite after intake responses. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
